title: biosig-zarr format version 3: view array metadata document
description: The zarr.json of one view level (a downsampled minimum and maximum envelope of level 0, for rendering only) of a uniform group in a format version 3 store, transcribed from spec/index.md on the branch draft/3.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two values or two documents, such as the length of a level and the one below it, downsample_factor and the group's view_downsample, or the missing value of level 0, are not expressed. Unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: View pyramid: the view arrays a group's view_levels lists.

node_type.$comment: View pyramid: a view level is an array.

shape.$comment: View pyramid: shape [2, n_channels, n_L]; along axis 0, index 0 is the minimum and index 1 is the maximum.

prefixItems.$comment: View pyramid: axis 0 has the minimum and the maximum.

codecs.$comment: View pyramid: view arrays are not sharded, and the chain is bytes with little-endian byte order, then blosc with the zstd compressor.

attributes.$comment: View pyramid: the REQUIRED rows of the view array attribute table.

level.description: View pyramid: the level number, 1 or greater.
